info.title: 1stFoxyGame API
info.description: R3/R4 persistent PostgreSQL profile, controlled provisioned accounts, server-replayed combat, atomic fixed-point economy and equipment. No signup. Same-origin JSON mutations require CSRF. Snapshot incompatible handling never resets property.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-foxy-session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque revocable 30-day server session. Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, no Domain. Production __Host-foxy-session; development foxy-session. X-CSRF-Token required on authenticated mutations.

operationId.description: Client-generated once per intent. Retry the identical payload with the same ID.

RunFinishRequest.description: Untrusted summary. It cannot directly grant currency. R3 reward protocol must include replayable commands/checkpoints before enabling economic settlement.

anyOf.description: Unsupported stored snapshot; client must use trusted runId to close only the run and retain permanent property.
Unsupported stored snapshot; client must use trusted runId to close only the run and retain permanent property.

RunLedger.ownership: Trusted caller supplies authenticated account subject; no unauthenticated accountId route.
guarantees: runId and server-generated seed bound to account and catalog/rules versions
atomic bounded batches with canonical payload deduplication
one enemy hit per cast and three distinct casts for the R2 boss
terminal runs reject new events and all reward payloads
limits: In-memory technical ledger; process restart loses runs.
Client-authoritative R2 events are not geometry verification, anti-cheat, persistence or economic reward authorization.
R3 must add authenticated durable run/economy transaction before exposing mutation endpoints.
